scpi_simple.subsystems.acquire module¶

class scpi_simple.subsystems.acquire.Acquire(instrument)[source]¶

Bases: object

Acquire subsystem

For the configuration and retrieval of data acquisition settings on the oscilloscope. This includes setting the acquisition mode, number of acquisitions, and controlling the acquisition state.

scpi_simple.subsystems.apply module¶

class scpi_simple.subsystems.apply.Apply(instrument)[source]¶

Bases: object

Apply subsystem For setting the output voltage and current on the power supply as a unified command. This provides a convenient method for configuring the power supply with a single call, rather than setting voltage and current separately.

set(channel: str, voltage: float, current: float)[source]¶

Set the output voltage and current for the specified channel. :param channel: The channel to set. :type channel: str :param voltage: The voltage to set. :type voltage: float :param current: The current to set. :type current: float

scpi_simple.subsystems.data module¶

class scpi_simple.subsystems.data.Data(instrument)[source]¶

Bases: object

Data subsystem for retrieving and setting data-related parameters on the instrument. This includes configuring the data source, encoding, data width, and retrieving waveform preamble information such as x increment and y scaling factors.

get_curve()[source]¶

Query the waveform data points as python integers.

Convert to voltage as follows: voltage = (raw - y_off) * y_mult + y_zero

Returns:

The raw waveform data points as integers, which can be converted to voltage values.

scpi_simple.subsystems.system module¶

class scpi_simple.subsystems.system.System(instrument)[source]¶

Bases: object

Subsystem for controlling system-level functions of the instrument, such as beeping.

beep()[source]¶

Trigger an immediate beep from the instrument. This can be used for audible notifications or alerts.

Note: The availability and behavior of the beep function may depend on the specific instrument model and its configuration.
